subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II request and secure upload options
messages:
From: Jaya Patel <j.patel@acme-corp.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security-requests@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — vendor assessment window and artifacts

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

We're starting Acme's vendor security questionnaire for Redwood and need your SOC 2 Type II materials to complete our assessment. Can you please confirm the following as soon as possible?

1) Do you have a finalized SOC 2 Type II report covering a continuous period (start/end dates) and the report date? Please include the audit firm name.
2) If the audit period doesn't overlap our required control window (Jan 1 2026 — Dec 31 2026), are you able to provide a bridge letter to extend coverage for our assessment?
3) Preferred secure transfer methods: we do not accept public links. We can accept presigned Azure SAS links or an SFTP drop. Which options do you support?
4) Minimal attachments we need: report (pdf), bridge letter (if applicable), control mapping (CAIQ/SIG/controls matrix), retention and access logs sample (redacted), and point-of-contact for follow-ups.

Target timing: we'd like to have artifacts by 2026-12-15. If that's not possible, please indicate an ETA and any gating items (e.g., legal redaction).

If helpful, include a short preferred reply template we can share with our procurement team for inbound evidence.

Thanks,
Jaya Patel
Director, Vendor Security
Acme Corporation
j.patel@acme-corp.com
security-requests@acme-corp.com

--
Note: Please do not forward the raw audit report to uncontrolled aliases; if you must, redact client names in attachments.

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Jaya Patel <j.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — vendor assessment window and artifacts

Hi Jaya — quick ack and plan from our side. Thanks for the clear asks.

Summary / next steps (short):
- We have a finalized SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30 (CPA: NorthBridge Audit LLP). The report date is 2025-07-18.
- We can provide a bridge letter to cover calendar 2026 for control continuity; it is standard practice and we can produce a signed bridge within 3 business days of request.
- Secure transfer options we support: presigned Azure SAS (time-limited, IP-restricted), SFTP to a customer-specified endpoint (FTPS not preferred), and an encrypted ZIP on a secure transfer ticket. We do not send unprotected public links.
- Typical deliverables we can provide now: report pdf (redwood_soc2_typeII_summary_2024.pdf), controls matrix (CAIQ mapping csv), brief retention/log samples (redacted), and a signed bridge letter.

Proposed timeline:
- 12/08: confirm which transfer method you prefer
- 12/09: we upload the summary + controls matrix
- 12/10–12/11: deliver bridge letter (if requested) and any additional redactions requested by your legal/procurement team

If you need a single-line response we can give procurement, use the template below (free to paste):
"Redwood Inference will provide a SOC 2 Type II report (audit firm: NorthBridge Audit LLP), a controls mapping (CAIQ), and a signed bridge letter to cover calendar 2026. We will upload artifacts via a time-limited Azure SAS link. Arrival ETA: 2026-12-09."

I'll attach our intake checklist and the one-line templates for internal teams. If legal needs to redline anything, loop Marissa. If security needs sample logs, loop Neha.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: soc2-intake-checklist.xlsx; one-line-templates.txt

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 10:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — vendor assessment window and artifacts

Rafael — quick note from legal/procurement POV.

- Good to offer the bridge letter. If Acme asks for the full unredacted report we should request a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or a mutual NDA for the transfer. Procurement often wants the full PDF for in-house review; if they insist, we should gate on an upload to a named contact and use watermarking.
- Also confirm whether they need a notarized signature on the bridge letter or if a firm-signed PDF is sufficient.

If they request it, I can draft a short transfer statement for procurement that keeps the report scope limited (redact third-party customer names).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Jaya Patel <j.patel@acme-corp.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: security-requests@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — vendor assessment window and artifacts

Thanks Rafael / Marissa. A couple of clarifications:

1) We cannot accept SFTP drops that place the file in a multi-tenant transfer location. Presigned Azure SAS scoped to our Acme tenant is preferred. The link must be valid for at least 72 hours and IP restricted to our uploaders (we will provide IPs).
2) Bridge letter: please include the audit firm name and the period you are bridge-covering (we prefer calendar 2026 coverage). A signed PDF from your audit contact is ideal — notarization not required.
3) Redaction: acceptable — redact customer PII and unrelated third-party names.

We will proceed with Azure SAS. I'll send the IP list and a secure upload path by EOD. If you could provide the one-line procurement template (exact text) that would speed approvals.

Best,
Jaya
